End-To-End Automation

How it works

From incoming bill or pre-alert email to verified system ledger — fully automated, fully auditable.

STEP 01

Document comes in

Via email, PDF, or customer upload — Docsynecx ingests it automatically.

PDF · Scan · Pre-Alert Email
STEP 02

Details extracted

Docsynecx extracts line items, party ledgers, GSTIN, and shipment specs.

Line Items · GSTIN · Container #
STEP 03

Cross-checked & matched

Reconciles BL vs Packing List, checks GST portal, and verifies PO matching.

GST Portal · 3-Way PO · BL vs PL
STEP 04

Pushed to system

Voucher or job is built and pushed directly into Tally or CargoWise.

Tally XML · CargoWise eAdaptor
STEP 05

Review exceptions only

Your team reviews only flagged discrepancies — clean records post automatically.

Exception Queue · Audit Log
